subject: design/native-routing-policy-v1
statement: In `strongest_satisfying` mode the resolver considers only the already-selected harness-role catalog and selects its unique strongest qualified profile if, and only if, that profile satisfies every requested minimum. Otherwise it returns `unsupported`. The mode changes candidate preference, not demand, harness, role, required review depth/count, or aggregation.
